item.title: Said & Checked, Environment and Climate, 2026-11-18: 1 contradicted (Melanie Stansbury)
item.description:
False or contradicted

  • Melanie Stansbury, U.S. Representative from New Mexico: “Cormorants have been protected under the Migratory Bird Treaty Act for over 100 years.” Contradicted. The Fish and Wildlife Service's 2003 Federal Register rule, read in the check, says double-crested cormorants 'have been protected under the MBTA since 1972', through the 1972 amendment to the 1936 U.S.-Mexico convention; that is 54 years, not over 100. The rule could not be read directly by the editor, so the result is held at contradicted rather than false.

16 statements by 6 officeholders. 13 checked: 6 supported, 6 unsettled, 1 contradicted · 1 not yet checked · 2 not checkable.
